contract: The existing durable subject-scoped privacy case ledger gains one concrete Spokeo HTML protocol adapter. It performs read-only exposure GETs against the documented /{first}-{last}/{state} search shape, discovers and validates the same-origin POST opt-out form, submits only listing_url and email after exact per-request approval plus the disabled-by-default live-submit environment gate, and confirms removal only through a later read-only negative rescan. broker_scan and broker_submit consent are checked before network access. Provider evidence is content-addressed without persisting submitted identity values.
remaining_limits: Local qualification uses a real HTTP contract server implementing the supported Spokeo request and response protocol; it is protocol evidence, not proof that the live broker currently accepts the flow
No live Spokeo opt-out was submitted during development; live submission requires both exact owner approval text and GIDEON_ALLOW_LIVE_SPOKEO_SUBMIT=1
Spokeo CAPTCHA, changed forms, cross-origin actions, redirects and inconclusive verification fail closed or require a human
Other data brokers remain catalog/manual-case entries without provider adapters; this slice does not claim full broker parity
Broker catalog and case metadata are owner-visible inside the secret local privacy database
No private database export or replication; central secret durability inventory remains root-owned
Dashboard registration and Privacy page composition remain root-owned integration hooks
acceptance_coverage: Spokeo positive and negative search pages become typed provider_protocol case observations
opt-out preparation validates a same-origin POST form and performs no submission
submission refuses missing approval and live mode remains disabled by default
approved contract submission discloses only profile URL and email and records no plaintext identity in case events
verification confirms removal only after a negative provider rescan and keeps a still-listed case awaiting processing
consent, revision, provider identity, CAPTCHA, protocol drift, origin and response-size boundaries fail closed
real no-store HTTP provider routes exercise the same adapter and durable lifecycle
